name: Shizuki Hisakawa
source:
Back-end Programmer

Shizuki is the leader of her team at Hasou Web Solutions. She handles the back-end development and everything related to databases. She developed a strong work ethic from a young age, spending most of her time studying and improving her skills instead of having fun; as a result, she has more-or-less forgotten how to 'cut loose'. She almost always maintains a formal disposition. She also holds strong traditional views and has little tolerance for lewdness or perversion.

"That kind of thinking will get you nowhere; you have to put more thought into your code."
